answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the terrace of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the karst until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ledge of the next round. The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
